Add a version bump keyword to the PR TITLE. It lands in the merge commit, which
is what the release workflow reads:

  #none    1.2.3 -> 1.2.3   eg. readme or comment change
  #patch   1.2.3 -> 1.2.4   eg. non-breaking fix
  #minor   1.2.3 -> 1.3.0   eg. new feature
  #major   1.2.3 -> 2.0.0   eg. breaking change

Without a keyword the release workflow falls back to a patch bump.
